user.title: Set up Energiemanager
user.description: Select the source entities for the zero-export filter, home battery, EV charger and AC buffer. See the [documentation]({documentation_url}) for details.

data_description.grid_power_sensor: Power sensor at the grid meter in watts (negative = export, positive = import).
data_description.battery_soc_sensor: State of charge sensor (0-100%) of the home battery (e.g. Anker Solarbank).
data_description.battery_discharge_lock_switch: Switch entity that locks home battery discharge while the EV is charging.
data_description.ev_power_sensor: Current EV charging power in watts.
data_description.ev_soc_sensor: Current state of charge (0-100%) of the EV battery.
data_description.ev_plugged_binary_sensor: Sensor indicating whether the charging cable is connected.
data_description.ev_ble_connected_binary_sensor: Sensor indicating local BLE-over-MQTT vehicle presence.
data_description.ev_current_number: Number entity controlling the 1-phase charging current setpoint (6-16 A).
data_description.ev_charging_switch: Switch entity to start or pause EV charging.
data_description.ev_wakeup_button: Button entity triggered to wake the vehicle before starting charging.
data_description.climate_entity: Climate entity used as a thermal buffer during medium PV surplus (500-1350 W).
